summary: Frontend-only verification of restored Goorin B2B Ops portal. All requested flows work: login page renders, demo (empty) login transitions to dashboard, typed credentials (demo@goorin.com/password123) login also works, all 8 sidebar nav items render without crashes, Marketplace shows 14 product cards with images, Add to Cart increments cart-count testid to 1 and shows floating cart bar with total, Settings opens to Team access tab with team members list. No browser console errors, no unhandled page exceptions on initial load or post-login. The prior screenshot-harness quirk was not reproduced in real browser session — login->dashboard transition is confirmed working.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth and all data are mocked in localStorage via src/lib/supabase.ts — expected per user choice (restore-as-is with mocked data). Not a bug.
sync_mock_session token uses a predictable timestamp; fine for demo, not production.
test_credentials: Demo login: empty email+password OR demo@goorin.com / password123 (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
seed_data_creation: None; app self-seeds mock data on first load.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App restored as-is and fully functional. Auth is mocked (localStorage sync_mock_session). Sidebar nav uses button role with exact names matching sidebar labels. cart-count testid updates correctly. No console errors observed.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. The previous manual attempts likely failed due to a screenshot-harness / localStorage isolation quirk; real Playwright browser session confirms login transitions to dashboard correctly on both demo (empty) and typed-credentials paths.
